say:1:1321805001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I see you've brought an interesting friend with you.
say:1:1321805001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I see you've brought an interesting friend with you.
say:1:1321805001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I see you've brought an interesting friend with you.

choice_prompt:2:1321805001.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I see you've brought an interesting friend with you.
choice_prompt:2:1321805001.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I see you've brought an interesting friend with you.
choice_prompt:2:1321805001.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I see you've brought an interesting friend with you.

say:3:1321805002:1.text: I hope my attendants didn't give you any trouble before letting you in, Mr. Faramor.
say:3:1321805002:1.source_cn: 希望进来前我的侍者没有难为你，法拉莫尔先生。

say:4:1321805004:1.text: A pleasure to make your acquaintance, Lord Ludovic. I assure you, I mean no harm. My only wish is to better understand the Graveborn of Whiteridge.
say:4:1321805004:1.source_cn: 很高兴认识你，柳博米尔先生。我并没有其他的意思，只是很...

say:5:1321805005:2.text: Graveborn... What an ironic and meaningless existence. Neither truly alive nor dead, we drift in chaos, only to be forgotten in silence...
say:5:1321805005:2.source_cn: 亡灵……讽刺而毫无意义的生命。游离于生与死的边缘，却从...

say:7:1321805007:1.text: I'm delighted to acquaint myself with an undead hunter, for your mission is of paramount importance—you help the dead, who linger without purpose, to embrace the rest they deserve.
say:7:1321805007:1.source_cn: 其实我很高兴能认识一位亡灵猎人。在我看来，你的工作有着...

say:8:1321805008:1.text: I'd love to show you around the manor and share its history, but before that, I'd appreciate it if you could first hear my request.
say:8:1321805008:1.source_cn: 我很愿意带你参观这座庄园，为你讲解这里的历史。但与此同...

say:10:1321805010:1.text: Before you stands a dead man who seeks eternal death rather than meaningless immortality. I'd be grateful if you could fulfill your duty here.
say:10:1321805010:1.source_cn: 在你的面前，就有一位视永生为虚无，而在追求永恒死亡的亡...

say:12:1321805012:2.text: Yes, you understood correctly. Please end me, the Graveborn in front of you.
say:12:1321805012:2.source_cn: 就是你想的那样，终结你眼前的亡灵——也就是我——的生命。

say:13:1321805013:1.text: But why? I'm afraid I can't oblige without knowing the reason.
say:13:1321805013:1.source_cn: 我不明白，您为何会有这样的请求？恕我不能答应。

say:14:1321805014:1.text: I imagine this must sound absurd to you.

say:15:1321805015:1.text: I only wish to understand your decision.
say:15:1321805015:1.source_cn: 我只是想尝试理解您的想法。

say:16:1321805016:1.text: My reasons are of little consequence. To you, I may be a friend of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s or the owner of this manor.
say:16:1321805016:1.source_cn: 我的想法并不重要，法拉莫尔先生，我只是希望你能尽到亡灵...
say:16:1321805016:1.male: My reasons are of little consequence. To you, I may be a friend of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s or the owner of this manor.
say:16:1321805016:1.female: My reasons are of little consequence. To you, I may be a friend of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s or the owner of this manor.

say:17:1321805017:1.text: But I must shatter that illusion. What you see before you is merely an empty husk, one that has endured the slow decay of time, spiraling into madness and despair. As I have said before, immortality is nothing but a curse.
say:17:1321805017:1.source_cn: 不……在你眼前的不过是一具空虚的躯体。太久的岁月会让人...

say:18:1321805018:1.text: Being an undead hunter does not mean I slay every Graveborn I encounter without reason. Someone as composed and well-mannered as yourself is not my enemy.
say:18:1321805018:1.source_cn: 虽然我是亡灵猎人，但我并不会毫无理由地猎杀每一位亡灵。...

say:19:1321805019:1.text: This manor, and you along with it, are still part of nature's cycle. So long as you possess the will to seek it, a new purpose may yet find you.
say:19:1321805019:1.source_cn: 这座庄园也好，您也好，只要您愿意，仍然可以遵循着自然循...

say:20:1321805020:1.text: Where death exists, so too does rebirth. Even when one purpose fades, time will offer another.
say:20:1321805020:1.source_cn: 死亡后总会迎来新生——在一个存在的意义消失后，时间会赋...

say:21:1321805021:1.text: Life holds meaning precisely because it is finite. When death becomes a luxury and eternity stretches endlessly before us, does that not strip life of its very essence?
say:21:1321805021:1.source_cn: 生命的意义只存在于可以计算的时日之内，一旦生命变为永恒...

say:22:1321805022:1.text: Yet, even in the harshest conditions, life persists. Trees take root in barren stone, and flowers bloom beneath the scorching sun and howling winds. Life will always find a way.
say:22:1321805022:1.source_cn: 野树会生在无土的石缝之中，荒漠里能找到坚韧地迎着烈日和...

say:23:1321805023:1.text: In my homeland, life is sacred for its purity and eternal through its cycle. That's the will of nature.
say:23:1321805023:1.source_cn: 在我的家乡，生命因纯粹而至高，因循环而永恒。这就是自然...

choice_prompt:24:1321805023.text: In my homeland, life is sacred for its purity and eternal through its cycle. That's the will of nature.
choice_prompt:24:1321805023.source_cn: 在我的家乡，生命因纯粹而至高，因循环而永恒。这就是自然的意志。

say:25:1321805024:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm glad you share my perspective on life. I believe you'll find a new purpose one day, Lord Ludovic.
say:25:1321805024:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm glad you share my perspective on life. I believe you'll find a new purpose one day, Lord Ludovic.
say:25:1321805024:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm glad you share my perspective on life. I believe you'll find a new purpose one day, Lord Ludovic.

say:26:1321805028:1.text: Mr. Faramor, are you certain you will not reconsider my request? I would have thought your duty was to fight a Graveborn, not engage in idle debate with one.
say:26:1321805028:1.source_cn: 亡灵猎人先生，你真的不再考虑一下我的请求吗？我想，你的...

say:27:1321805029:1.text: Or perhaps... you have only ever vanquished the Graveborn with words? If that is the case, I fear you are ill-suited for your profession.
say:27:1321805029:1.source_cn: 又或者说……你只会依靠辩论来战胜亡灵？这样看来，你所谓...

say:28:1321805030:1.text: Lord Ludovic, do you truly believe your life has lost all meaning?
say:28:1321805030:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔先生，你真的认为活着已经没有任何意义了吗？

say:31:1321805033:1.text: If that is your stance, then I apologize for troubling you.
say:31:1321805033:1.source_cn: 既然如此……很抱歉打扰您了，柳博米尔先生。

say:34:1321805035:1.text: No matter the circumstances, I cannot grant Lord Ludovic's request... It is unfortunate that our meeting ended on such terms.
say:34:1321805035:1.source_cn: 无论如何，我都无法答应这位柳博米尔先生的要求……看来这...

say:35:1321805036:1.text: Mr. Faramor, where are you heading next?
say:35:1321805036:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，接下来你打算去哪里？

say:36:1321805037:1.text: I gave Carolina my word—I'll be patrolling the area to watch for any rogue undead. Care to join me?
say:36:1321805037:1.source_cn: 既然已经答应了卡列琳娜女士，我准备去周边地区巡视一圈，...

say:37:1321805038:1.text: You bet! Sir Chippy would never pass up a chance to help the people!
say:37:1321805038:1.source_cn: 当然！这种事情怎么能少得了正义的骑士满满呢？！

choice:30:0:1.text: Um, should we call it a day?
choice:30:0:1.male: Um, should we call it a day?
choice:30:0:1.female: Um, should we call it a day?

say:40:1321805032:1.source_cn: 总觉得不能让两位先生继续辩论下去了……

choice:30:1:2.text: This is getting out of hand.
choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 这场会面发展到了我不理解的阶段
choice:30:1:2.male: This is getting out of hand.
choice:30:1:2.female: This is getting out of hand.

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 我赞同法拉莫尔的说法

say:42:1321805025:1.text: It's uncanny how well you understand me. Doesn't Mr. Faramor seem more like a preacher than an undead hunter? How amusing.
say:42:1321805025:1.source_cn: 的确，你一向能理解我。真有趣，比起亡灵猎人，这位法拉莫...
say:42:1321805025:1.male: It's uncanny how well you understand me. Doesn't Mr. Faramor seem more like a preacher than an undead hunter? How amusing.
say:42:1321805025:1.female: It's uncanny how well you understand me. Doesn't Mr. Faramor seem more like a preacher than an undead hunter? How amusing.

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 我觉得柳博米尔有道理

say:43:1321805026:1.text: Ah, simply a discussion on the nature of life, nothing more.
say:43:1321805026:1.source_cn: 只是一些关于生命的讨论而已。
say:43:1321805026:1.male: Ah, simply a discussion on the nature of life, nothing more.
say:43:1321805026:1.female: Ah, simply a discussion on the nature of life, nothing more.

choice:24:2:3.source_cn: 太深奥了，你们到底在说什么……

say:45:1321805003:1.text: Huh, I must have come off as harsh often for you to doubt that... To be more precise, I'm curious, as you have an undead hunter with you.
say:45:1321805003:1.source_cn: 看来我得怀疑过去我讲话是否过于刻薄了……其实我只是很好...

say:45:1321805003:1.female: Huh, I must have come off as harsh often for you to doubt that... To be more precise, I'm curious, as you have an undead hunter with you.
